finding.text: Docs gap: `ux/Auth/doc/decisions.md` is the module's decisions page and says nothing of the Google/Video/SignIn choices (Google first, one button over video, mock-vs-real). Nothing in the diff touches `doc/`, and the readme's "Use" and "Files" got the new files but "Watch out" got no entry for the GIS script load or the `/api/config` fallback.

Index gap: `ux/Auth/files.jsonl` lists `google/` and the new files, but `google/files.jsonl` carries `V01.png`/`V02.png` added then marked `gone`; the two stills `V01.jpg`/`V02.jpg` are indexed, yet `V02.jpg` is used by nothing (page.js only uses V01). An unused committed image is clutter: use it or drop it.

A fresh agent cannot continue from the task folder alone: `signin/session.jsonl` has the "landed" line but the requirements' item 6 asks for a `smoke.mjs` result and the screenshot paths. No log line states a smoke pass, and the test result for `GoogleButton.test.mjs` is not recorded either. Add both to the task log.
The Figma Forms page was named as the source to follow ("if it is there when you build"); no log line says whether it was there or compared (requirement 3).

`layout.json` for the google page reports `tab_rows 4` at 1200/1920/3440, but sheet.png shows the page tab bar on one row at every width; the measurement is counting the whole tabs band, not wrapped tabs (the Auth overview reads 1). At 400 the tab bar clips at the right edge ("MAGIC-AUTH", then a cut-off tab), which is the shared scroller, not this diff.

3440: the three columns sit with `empty 0.50`, the widest column paragraphs run 628px; fine, but the sign-in view column is much shorter than the button column, leaving a ragged bottom (shots/…-google/3440.png).
The shots' 404 console error appears on the baseline `/framework/ux/Auth/` too, so it is not from this diff.
Widths: all four (400, 1200, 1920, 3440) were given for two pages.
